entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Move unified validation APIs to separate package #62070
  • When using JsonPolymorphic with derived types that share a common base class and have similar property structures, the OpenAPI generator throws an exception during schema generation. #62068
  • Perf regression: httpsys-header-symbols #62062
  • Perf regression: kestrel-encoded-url, kestrel-encoded-url, kestrel-header-symbols #62061
  • Perf regression: json_middleware, json_middleware, kestrel-header-symbols #62060
  • Perf improvement: httpsys-encoded-url, kestrel-hostheader-mismatch #62059
  • Perf improvement: httpsys-hostheader-mismatch, kestrel-hostheader-mismatch, multiple_queries #62058

Closed

  • [OpenAPI] XML source generator does not correctly escape `<see>` tags #61042
  • Add host.docker.internal and host.containers.internal to the dev cert SAN #61155
  • Validation bug of `DateOnly` for minimalAPI in ASP.NET Core 10 Preview 4 #62065
  • Benchmark stopped running: blazorWebInteractiveAuto, blazorWebInteractiveServer, blazorWebInteractiveWebAssembly #61919
  • Benchmark stopped running: blazorwasmbenchmark #61918
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel.Core.ListenOptions.Protocols is internal in Microsoft.AspNetCore v2.3.0 #61823
